steps.title: Open the daily dashboard
steps.narration: Trendora opens on the daily dashboard — your one-glance read on the market. It pulls today's market regime, market breadth, and the strongest sectors into a single screen, so you can size up the day in seconds.
steps.point_out: The 'Market Regime' card shows a colour-coded label (e.g. Risk-on) with a 0-100 score and the components behind it. Three breadth cards on the right are each marked 'universe-relative', a 'Data as-of' date sits top-right, and the Candidate Counts and Top Themes cards honestly read 'pending' instead of faking a zero.

steps.title: Open the full sector leaderboard
steps.narration: Those Top Sectors are only the head of a full ranking. A click on 'Sectors' in the sidebar opens the complete leaderboard of every sector and industry ETF, ranked by its Sector Score.
steps.point_out: A dense table ordered highest-score first — each row carries an A-E score badge, its strength versus the SPY benchmark, how far it trades below its 52-week high, and a trend label. SPY appears only as the excluded benchmark, never as a ranked leader.

steps.title: Expand a row to see what drove the score
steps.narration: Click any row to unfold the reasons behind its score — a ranking should never be a number you have to take on trust.
steps.point_out: The top row expands into a Component / Detail / Contribution grid: relative strength over 1m, 3m and 6m, the moving-average stack, distance from the 52-week high, and volume trend — each with the contribution it added to the score.
